items.title: 68357_Jimmy Maxwell oral history interview
items.q: John Wilson said it's just a death wish they have.

ctx.x: Well, maybe. Well, John Wilson said it's just a death wish they have. They don't turn out too good. But of course Charlie Parker would sound good with people banging on tincans behind him. And some of those rhythm sections he had sounded like that. I listened to some of those earlier records and I can't believe what I hear. Some of those rhythm sections weren't too good.

Isn't that amazing? And Louis Armstrong, the same way. The most horrible -- all through his life, I remember I listened to those bands and they were just horrible. And he was blowing this most beautiful stuff (inaudible).
